title: Research: completed-callee substitution at PR #2234's BIT leaves and headers
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR2234's weighted leaf and reversed header ADD implement each ordinary field exchange digit by digit. Replacing only the leaf would leave the header width toll unchanged. This package implements a temporary two-field radix-to-binary adapter and proves that substituting a previously completed binary callee at **both** sites gives their required `O(V w^(1-a))` charge, under the explicit earlier-callee and retained stream contracts.

The adapter pads only the two exchanged fields, increases active volume by less than four, invokes one completed binary call on the whole stream, and restricts after the complete endpoint. It preserves arbitrary complete prefix/gap/suffix fields and uses actual zero-bit padding. A source-bound leaf successor has four calls per pair; the unchanged source header code uses two calls for a reversed ADD, at width `w-1`. The width-zero header boundary is identity.

**Status:** scoped conditional proof, executable adapter and finite endpoint audit. The inherited bootstrap algebra gives the conditional second-round ordinary saving `1699995087/10^12` at unchanged `c=17/10000`. This remains below the selected BIT rate and is not a new multiplication exponent, selected supplier, optimized moment or full all-size admission. The prior completed fast algorithm, physical caller/preparation/hosting/parking and moment contracts remain hypotheses. The finite callback is a slow completed digit-bucket algorithm.

All changes are in `research/bit2234-callee-substitution/`. Frozen source copies remain byte-for-byte unchanged. README contains the proof, evidence boundary and open questions; SOURCES.json records Git blobs and SHA256 pins.

## Validation

On CPython 3.12.3, standard library only:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/bit2234-callee-substitution/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit2234-callee-substitution --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit2234-callee-substitution
```

Registered normal and optimized replays pass, including:

- 40 complete padded-exchange cases / 341,920 coordinates; additionally all 512 Boolean payloads at `Q=3` through a bits-only callback;
- seven weighted leaf cases / 59,064 coordinates, with full spectator and arbitrary-payload permutation checks;
- 1,480 executions of unchanged source header ADD bodies / 457,280 coordinates, both orientations and ten dyadic coefficients;
- actual source call inventory and exact rational conditional corollary;
- 16 semantic/receipt controls, including clean identity instead of swap, dirty return, wrong spectator, dummy leakage, inverse/sign/carry/return-swap faults, and typed receipt checks;
- relocated Git-free replay, one public-CLI source corruption and four public-CLI receipt corruptions.

Expected output includes:

```text
PASS_BIT2234_CALLEE_SUBSTITUTION adapter_cases=40 leaf_cases=7 header_cases=1480 controls=16
PASS_BIT2234_CALLEE_INTEGRITY relocated=1 source_faults=1 receipt_faults=4
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/bit2234-callee-substitution outcome=completed
```

The final registered run took about 49 seconds. Metadata/source pins and `git diff --check` pass. The all-width implication is a written proof under named hypotheses, not an extrapolation from these cases. No full supplier cold replay, large GL64 payload, actual fast prior-callee execution, formal-kernel build, selected fourteen-stage coefficient audit, hosted CI or independent human review is claimed.

The registered replay (with the integrity group) was run again on the final package bytes before submission, under an 8 GiB memory cap: it passed in about 50 seconds and left the worktree unchanged. The eight copied PR #2234 and PR #2087 files match those heads by Git blob; they keep their authors' original wording.

## Open next questions

The README and TASK.json give two bounded follow-ups:

1. Join an actual completed faster binary callee to one nonadjacent exchange, checking arbitrary dirty spectators, local work lifetime and the full return boundary. Completed caller review and a faster backend remain prerequisites; PR2364 and Discussion2319's prefix/dispatch work are complementary.
2. Bind the substitution to one sharper retained moment/stopping choice and selected stage, with its own preparation domain, reserve and previous completed algorithm. Current source and coefficient obligations prevent selected admission here.

## Workflow feedback (optional)
